dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: Yes. This is a most quiet and secluded place, perfect for solitary contemplation.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: I may enjoy wandering the world like a cloud, but I still need a place to return to after my travels.

dialogues.speaker: Zibai
dialogues.text: And well... Heh. Let's just say this place is much better than where I used to "live alone."
